title: The Promise of Port Alder
author: E. M. Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Delacroix, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
